To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the Notch pathway is an evolutionarily-conserved signaling pathway that plays an essential role in development, differentiation, and tissue patterning and (ii) the Notch signaling pathway plays a critical role in cancer and is a target for cancer therapy.
the Notch signaling pathway is a critical regulator of tumor behavior and response of tumors to therapy.
Notch pathway is a complex signaling pathway with multiple roles in normal development and cancer.

the role of Notches in cancer and the development of Notch inhibitors as anticancer agents.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Notch pathway is critical in many cancers and that the context of Notch activation is critical in determining its impact.
the Notch pathway is a critical player in the development and maintenance of multiple cancers.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Notch pathway plays critical roles in tumor initiation, growth, and metastasis, and therefore represents an attractive target for cancer therapy.
the Notch pathway is a critical regulator of cell-fate decisions and is a major player in the pathogenesis and development of cancer.
